leadText:
(Japanese: チョータ Chōta) is a Pokémon Trainer and a character of the day who was set to appear in AG101 (unaired).

Chōta lives on Jojo Island with his . He is seen trying to calm a group of , suggesting he is kind and likes Pokémon.
